mapper.select: SELECT /* User.retrieveSsoUserList */ USER_NAME , SYSTEM_CODE , LANGUAGE_CODE , TIMEZONE_TYPE_CODE , TO_CHAR( APPLICATION_USER_ID ) AS APPLICATION_USER_ID , TO_CHAR( EMPLOYEE_ID ) AS EMPLOYEE_ID , MAIL_ADDR , SUBSTR(mail_addr,1,INSTR(MAIL_ADDR,'@')-1) AS SSO_ID , NVL(FULL_NAME_LOCAL,ENGLISH_FULL_NAME) as "FULL_NAME_LOCAL" , DEPARTMENT_CODE , TITLE_NAME , ORGANIZATION_NAME_ENG as "ORGANIZATION_NAME" , OFFICE_PHONE_NUMBER , NVL(SCREEN_DESIGN_THEME_ID, 'A' ) AS SCREEN_DESIGN_THEME_ID , NVL( TO_CHAR( DEFAULT_ORG_ID ), '89' ) AS DEFAULT_ORG_ID , DEFAULT_ORG_NAME , DEFAULT_ORG_SHORT_CODE , DEFAULT_ORG_ID_USE_FLAG , REQUEST_REGION_CODE , REQUEST_REGION_NAME , REQUEST_REGION_CODE_USE_FLAG , SERVER_TIME_DIFFERENCE_SEQS , MENU_USE_FLAG , OU_USE_FLAG FROM LGCOM_USER_M_V WHERE TO_CHAR(APPLY_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(APPLY_END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND SUBSTR(MAIL_ADDR,1,INSTR(MAIL_ADDR,'@')-1) = #{ssoId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY USER_NAME
mapper.update: UPDATE LGCOM_USER_M lum SET lum.system_code = #{systemCode}, lum.MENU_USE_FLAG = 'N' WHERE APPLICATION_USER_ID = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* User.retrieveUserRoleList */ SYSTEM_CODE , MODULE_CODE , ROLE_CODE FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_AUTHO_V WHERE APPLICATION_USER_ID = #{applicationUserId}

{ CALL /* User.validateLoginProc */ LGCOM_VALIDATE_LOGIN_PROC(#{userName, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{password, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultCode, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resultMsg, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) }
{ CALL /* User.testProcedure */ MO_GLOBAL.SET_POLICY_CONTEXT(#{gubun, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgId, mode=IN, jdbcType=DECIMAL}) }
